q: And this Anti-Christ, whose name was Korihor

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Korihor teaches there is no Christ
q: began to preach unto the people that there should be no Christ.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Korihor denies God
q: And he answered, Nay.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Korihor causes whoredoms (among many women and men)
q: leading away many women, and also men, to commit whoredoms

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Korihor is possessed by devil (with a lying spirit)
q: Behold, I know that thou believest, but thou art possessed with a lying spirit, and ye have put off the Spirit of God that it may have no place in you; but the devil has power over you

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Korihor is struck with Korihor's dumbness (by the power of God)
q: Now when Alma had said these words, Korihor was struck dumb, that he could not have utterance, according to the words of Alma.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Korihor's dumbness is smitten by God (becomes dumb)
q: therefore if thou shalt deny again, behold God shall smite thee, that thou shalt become dumb, that thou shalt never open thy mouth any more

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: people of Ammon is formerly Lamanites
q: the people of Ammon, who were once the people of the Lamanites.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: curse is not taken off Korihor
q: And it came to pass that the curse was not taken off of Korihor

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Korihor begs for food (from house to house)
q: but he was cast out, and went about from house to house begging for his food.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Korihor's death is caused by being run upon and trodden down
q: behold, he was run upon and trodden down, even until he was dead.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Christ is prophesied of by prophets (concerning his coming)
q: the prophecies which had been spoken by the prophets, concerning the coming of Christ.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: prophecies are spoken by prophets (concerning the coming of Christ)
q: the prophecies which had been spoken by the prophets, concerning the coming of Christ.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: prophets are holy holy
q: Why do ye speak against all the prophecies of the holy prophets?

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: God is a Supreme Creator
q: yea, even the earth, and all things that are upon the face of it, yea, and its motion, yea, and also all the planets which move in their regular form do witness that there is a Supreme Creator.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: earth testifies of God (together with all things upon its face and its motion)
q: yea, even the earth, and all things that are upon the face of it, yea, and its motion, yea, and also all the planets which move in their regular form do witness that there is a Supreme Creator.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: planets testify of God (as witnesses of a Supreme Creator)
q: also all the planets which move in their regular form do witness that there is a Supreme Creator.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Lamanites is driven out of land of Jershon
q: after the people of Ammon were established in the land of Jershon, yea, and also after the Lamanites were driven out of the land

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: the Atonement of Christ is denied by Korihor (for the sins of men)
q: telling them that there could be no atonement made for the sins of men

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: remission of sins is seen by Ye
q: Ye look forward and say that ye see a remission of your sins.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: sign is given by Alma (to Korihor)
q: Now Alma said unto him: This will I give unto thee for a sign, that thou shalt be struck dumb, according to my words

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: sign is Korihor's dumbness
q: Now Alma said unto him: This will I give unto thee for a sign, that thou shalt be struck dumb, according to my words

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Korihor's dumbness is power of God
q: I know that I am dumb, for I cannot speak; and I know that nothing save it were the power of God could bring this upon me

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: devil deceives Korihor (appearing in the form of an angel)
q: But behold, the devil hath deceived me; for he appeared unto me in the form of an angel

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: devil teaches there is no God (to Korihor)
q: And he said unto me: There is no God; yea, and he taught me that which I should say.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: peace is throughout all the land
q: there began to be continual peace throughout all the land.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Ammon is a high priest (over the people of Ammon)
q: they took him, and bound him, and carried him before Ammon, who was a high priest over that people.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Zoramites are separated from Nephites
q: among a people who had separated themselves from the Nephites and called themselves Zoramites

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Zoramites are led by Zoram
q: being led by a man whose name was Zoram

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: law of Moses is taught by prophets (until it should be fulfilled)
q: for they were taught to keep the law of Moses until it should be fulfilled.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: peace is present during reign of the judges (sixteenth year)
q: And thus the people did have no disturbance in all the sixteenth year of the reign of the judges over the people of Nephi.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: law of Moses is observed by Nephites (until it should be fulfilled)
q: and they were strict in observing the ordinances of God, according to the law of Moses; for they were taught to keep the law of Moses until it should be fulfilled.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: law against belief is forbidden by God (contrary to the commands of God)
q: Now there was no law against a man’s belief; for it was strictly contrary to the commands of God that there should be a law which should bring men on to unequal grounds.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: law against belief does not punish belief
q: but if he did not believe in him there was no law to punish him.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: crimes are judged by law (according to their crimes)
q: For there was a law that men should be judged according to their crimes.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Alma receives tidings (that the Zoramites were perverting the ways of the Lord)
q: Now it came to pass that after the end of Korihor, Alma having received tidings that the Zoramites were perverting the ways of the Lord

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Alma prays for Alma's fellow laborers (for comfort and strength in Christ)
q: O Lord, wilt thou comfort my soul, and give unto me success, and also my fellow laborers who are with me—yea, Ammon, and Aaron, and Omner, and also Amulek and Zeezrom and also my two sons—yea, even all these wilt thou comfort, O Lord.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Zoramites is a dissenters from the Nephites
q: Now the Zoramites were dissenters from the Nephites

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Zoramites follows Zoram (as their leader)
q: Zoram, who was their leader, was leading the hearts of the people to bow down to dumb idols

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Zoramites lives in Antionum
q: Now the Zoramites had gathered themselves together in a land which they called Antionum

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Zoramites builds synagogues
q: they found that the Zoramites had built synagogues

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Zoramites worships after a manner which Alma and his brethren had never beheld (on one day of the week)
q: they did gather themselves together on one day of the week, which day they did call the day of the Lord; and they did worship after a manner which Alma and his brethren had never beheld

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Zoramites believes coming of Christ (denied)
q: and also thou hast made it known unto us that there shall be no Christ.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Zoramites believes in salvation (for themselves as a chosen people)
q: thou hast elected us that we shall be saved, whilst all around us are elected to be cast by thy wrath down to hell

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Zoramites is characterized by pride (hearts lifted up in boasting)
q: Yea, and he also saw that their hearts were lifted up unto great boasting, in their pride.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Zoramites values riches (their hearts are set upon them)
q: for he saw that they were a wicked and a perverse people; yea, he saw that their hearts were set upon gold, and upon silver, and upon all manner of fine goods.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Alma has sons Shiblon
q: the names of those whom he took with him were Shiblon and Corianton

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Nephites fears correspondence between the Zoramites and the Lamanites (because it could cause great loss)
q: Now the Nephites greatly feared that the Zoramites would enter into a correspondence with the Lamanites, and that it would be the means of great loss on the part of the Nephites.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Antionum is located east of Zarahemla
q: which was east of the land of Zarahemla

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Antionum borders seashore (nearly)
q: which lay nearly bordering upon the seashore

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Antionum is south of land of Jershon
q: which was south of the land of Jershon

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Ammon is a Alma's fellow laborers (missionary companion)
q: also my fellow laborers who are with me—yea, Ammon

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Aaron is a Alma's fellow laborers (missionary companion)
q: also my fellow laborers who are with me—yea, Ammon, and Aaron

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Omner is a Alma's fellow laborers (missionary companion)
q: also my fellow laborers who are with me—yea, Ammon, and Aaron, and Omner

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Amulek is a Alma's fellow laborers (missionary companion)
q: also my fellow laborers who are with me—yea, Ammon, and Aaron, and Omner, and also Amulek

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Zeezrom is a Alma's fellow laborers (missionary companion)
q: also my fellow laborers who are with me—yea, Ammon, and Aaron, and Omner, and also Amulek and Zeezrom

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Himni remains in church (in Zarahemla)
q: and Himni he did leave in the church in Zarahemla

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Alma has sons Corianton
q: the names of those whom he took with him were Shiblon and Corianton

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: synagogues contains Rameumptom (a raised central place for standing)
q: For they had a place built up in the center of their synagogue, a place for standing, which was high above the head, and the top thereof would only admit one person.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Rameumptom is a holy stand (the name means the holy stand)
q: Now the place was called by them Rameumptom, which, being interpreted, is the holy stand.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Rameumptom is used for worship at the holy stand (one person at a time)
q: Therefore, whosoever desired to worship must go forth and stand upon the top thereof

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: prayer is offered God (daily by the church's faithful practice)
q: Neither would they observe the performances of the church, to continue in prayer and supplication to God daily

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: word of God has effect on minds of the people (more powerful than the sword or anything else that had happened to them)
q: it had had more powerful effect upon the minds of the people than the sword, or anything else, which had happened unto them

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: preaching of the word leads to just conduct (has a great tendency)
q: as the preaching of the word had a great tendency to lead the people to do that which was just

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Zoramites perverts ways of the Lord (through great errors)
q: Alma having received tidings that the Zoramites were perverting the ways of the Lord

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Zoram leads Zoramites (toward dumb idols)
q: Zoram, who was their leader, was leading the hearts of the people to bow down to dumb idols

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: the Spirit of the Lord fills Alma's fellow laborers (after Alma laid hands on them)
q: And behold, as he clapped his hands upon them, they were filled with the Holy Spirit.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Alma has son Helaman (eldest son)
q: Now the eldest of his sons he took not with him, and his name was Helaman

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Alma's prayer requests success (in bringing the Zoramites again unto God in Christ)
q: O Lord, wilt thou grant unto us that we may have success in bringing them again unto thee in Christ.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Alma's prayer requests power and wisdom (to bring the Zoramites again unto God)
q: therefore, give unto us, O Lord, power and wisdom that we may bring these, our brethren, again unto thee.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: God provides strength (so Alma and his companions suffer no manner of afflictions except as swallowed up in Christ's joy)
q: And the Lord provided for them that they should hunger not, neither should they thirst; yea, and he also gave them strength

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Christ comforts their souls (in Christ)
q: Yea, wilt thou comfort their souls in Christ.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Alma leads Ammon (among the Zoramites)
q: Therefore he took Ammon, and Aaron, and Omner

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Alma leads Aaron (among the Zoramites)
q: Therefore he took Ammon, and Aaron, and Omner

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Alma leads Omner (among the Zoramites)
q: Therefore he took Ammon, and Aaron, and Omner

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Alma leads Amulek (among the Zoramites)
q: but the former three he took with him, and also Amulek and Zeezrom, who were at Melek

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Alma leads Zeezrom (among the Zoramites)
q: but the former three he took with him, and also Amulek and Zeezrom, who were at Melek

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Alma is a teacher (teaching the people)
q: Now, as Alma was teaching and speaking unto the people upon the hill Onidah

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: the poor in heart is a poor class of people (poor in heart because of poverty as to worldly things)
q: who were those of whom we have been speaking, of whom were poor in heart, because of their poverty as to the things of the world

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: the poor in heart is humbled by affliction (truly)
q: for he beheld that their afflictions had truly humbled them

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: the poor in heart is prepared to hear word of God (through their afflictions)
q: and that they were in a preparation to hear the word

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: synagogues are places for worship of the Lord (according to the people's former understanding)
q: do ye suppose that ye cannot worship God save it be in your synagogues only?

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: synagogues are built by the poor in heart (with their own hands)
q: for they have cast us out of our synagogues which we have labored abundantly to build with our own hands

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: word of God is preached in synagogues
q: began to preach the word of God unto the people, entering into their synagogues

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: word of God is preached in houses
q: and into their houses; yea, and even they did preach the word in their streets

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: word of God is preached in streets
q: and even they did preach the word in their streets

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: worship of the Lord is not limited to synagogues (not only in synagogues)
q: do ye suppose that ye cannot worship God save it be in your synagogues only?

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: worship of the Lord is not limited to once in a week (not only once weekly)
q: do ye suppose that ye must not worship God only once in a week?

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Alma teaches the poor in heart (after seeing their afflictions had humbled them)
q: Therefore he did say no more to the other multitude; but he stretched forth his hand, and cried unto those whom he beheld, who were truly penitent

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: poverty causes humility (when people are despised and cast out because of it)
q: it is because that ye are cast out, that ye are despised of your brethren because of your exceeding poverty, that ye are brought to a lowliness of heart; for ye are necessarily brought to be humble

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: affliction causes humility (among the poor in heart)
q: for he beheld that their afflictions had truly humbled them

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: humility leads to repentance (when a person is compelled to be humble)
q: for a man sometimes, if he is compelled to be humble, seeketh repentance

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: repentance finds mercy (whoever repents)
q: and now surely, whosoever repenteth shall find mercy

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: repentance leads to salvation (when endured to the end)
q: and he that findeth mercy and endureth to the end the same shall be saved

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: faith in Christ is not perfect knowledge (of things)
q: faith is not to have a perfect knowledge of things

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: faith in Christ hopes for things which are not seen (which are true)
q: therefore if ye have faith ye hope for things which are not seen, which are true

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: faith in Christ experiments upon my words (exercise a particle of faith)
q: if ye will awake and arouse your faculties, even to an experiment upon my words, and exercise a particle of faith

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: knowledge is perfect in that thing (when the word has swelled the soul and enlightened understanding)
q: Yea, your knowledge is perfect in that thing

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: experiment upon the word consists of planting the seed (to test whether the seed is good)
q: ye have tried the experiment, and planted the seed

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Alma teaches faith in Christ
q: And now as I said concerning faith—faith is not to have a perfect knowledge of things

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: seed (Alma's listeners' seed) is planted in heart (when a person gives place to it)
q: Now, we will compare the word unto a seed. Now, if ye give place, that a seed may be planted in your heart

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: seed (Alma's listeners' seed) is good true seed (if it is not cast out by unbelief)
q: behold, if it be a true seed, or a good seed, if ye do not cast it out by your unbelief

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: seed (Alma's listeners' seed) enlarges soul (when it begins to swell)
q: it beginneth to enlarge my soul

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: seed (Alma's listeners' seed) enlightens understanding (when it begins to swell)
q: yea, it beginneth to enlighten my understanding

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: seed (Alma's listeners' seed) strengthens faith in Christ (when it sprouts and begins to grow)
q: And now behold, will not this strengthen your faith? Yea, it will strengthen your faith: for ye will say I know that this is a good seed; for behold it sprouteth and beginneth to grow

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: seed (Alma's listeners' seed) brings forth its own likeness (every seed)
q: for every seed bringeth forth unto its own likeness

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: tree (the planted word) grows from seed (Alma's listeners' seed) (when the seed sprouts and begins to grow)
q: And behold, as the tree beginneth to grow

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: tree (the planted word) requires nourishment (with great care)
q: Let us nourish it with great care, that it may get root, that it may grow up, and bring forth fruit unto us

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: tree (the planted word) brings forth fruit (when nourished with much care)
q: if ye nourish it with much care it will get root, and grow up, and bring forth fruit

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: tree (the planted word) withers away (when neglected and scorched without root)
q: when the heat of the sun cometh and scorcheth it, because it hath no root it withers away

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Alma teaches experiment upon the word (as an exercise of faith)
q: But behold, if ye will awake and arouse your faculties, even to an experiment upon my words, and exercise a particle of faith

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: tree (the planted word) is nourished by faith in Christ (with great diligence and patience)
q: if ye will nourish the word, yea, nourish the tree as it beginneth to grow, by your faith with great diligence, and with patience

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: tree (the planted word) springs up unto everlasting life (when nourished by faith, diligence, and patience)
q: it shall take root; and behold it shall be a tree springing up unto everlasting life
